result.title: Retrieval-Augmented Initialization with Dual-Guided Inversion for Flow-Based Inverse Problem Solvers
result.summary: Flow models have recently emerged as powerful generative priors for solving inverse problems. Despite their success, most existing flow-based inverse problem solvers initialize the reconstruction process with random Gaussian noise. However, recent studies in image generation have shown that the choice of initial noise can significantly influence generation outcomes. The role of initialization as a distinct design choice in flow-based inverse problem solving remains comparatively underexplored. In this work, we systematically evaluate noise initialization strategies while holding the downstream flow-based inverse solver fixed. We propose Retrieval-Augmented Initialization with Dual-Guided Inversion (RA-DGI), a method that constructs improved initial noise by leveraging retrieved proxy clean images and dual-guided inversion. Extensive experiments across multiple inverse problems demonstrate that the quality of the initial noise substantially affects reconstruction fidelity and perceptual performance. RA-DGI outperforms standard random initialization and achieves superior results compared to inference-time scaling strategies, while requiring less computational overhead. These findings highlight initialization as a critical yet previously overlooked factor in flow-based inverse problem solvers.

AI.brief_summary: 论文固定下游 flow 逆问题求解器，系统比较不同噪声初始化策略，并提出 RA-DGI：借助检索到的代理干净图像与双引导反演构造更优的初始噪声，在多个逆问题上优于随机初始化与部分推理时扩展方法，且计算开销更低。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「初始 latent 状态显著影响后续生成/重建质量」的结论，可能为 LVR 中推理工作区如何初始化、以及用检索到的视觉证据播种初始状态提供类比线索，可供核查；但任务属于图像逆问题重建，与多模态推理距离较远。
